content:
Chem Progress is a leading chemical company based in the heart of Italy, specifically located at Via Romagna, 9 in San Giuliano Milanese (MI). With a commitment to innovation and sustainability, we specialize in the development and production of high-quality chemical products that cater to diverse industrial applications. Founded on the principles of scientific excellence and environmental stewardship, Chem Progress has positioned itself as a trusted partner for businesses seeking reliable chemical solutions.

Our extensive portfolio includes specialty chemicals, intermediates, and formulations designed to meet the evolving needs of various sectors, including pharmaceuticals, agriculture, and consumer goods. Driven by a passionate team of experts, we harness cutting-edge technology and state-of-the-art facilities to ensure that our products not only meet but exceed industry standards. 

At Chem Progress, we believe that progress is achieved through collaboration, research, and an unwavering commitment to quality. Our dedicated research and development team is constantly exploring new formulations and processes to enhance efficiency and reduce environmental impact. We take pride in our ability to provide tailored solutions that align with our clients’ specific requirements while adhering to the highest safety and regulatory standards. Join us as we continue to innovate and shape the future of the chemical industry, one solution at a time.
